description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of automated tests for the 'git worktree' subcommand. It tests various functionalities such as listing, adding, locking, pruning, and handling worktrees in different repository states, including bare repositories and linked worktrees. The script utilizes helper functions, runs git commands, and verifies expected outputs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets a specific git configuration for a test.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in input and verifies presence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command must fail.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or timestamp, used for timestamping commits.
